name: Two-Pass Dynamic Programming
summary: Seed zero cells with distance 0 and every 1 with infinity, then make two sweeps: top-left to bottom-right taking the best of the up/left neighbours, and bottom-right to top-left taking the best of the down/right neighbours.
visualizationIntent: init: build a distance grid — zeros are green, ones start at infinity (amber). pass 1: sweep top-left to bottom-right; each cell takes 1 + the smaller of its up and left neighbours. pass 2: sweep bottom-right to top-left; each cell takes 1 + the smaller of its down and right neighbours. Cells settle from amber (infinity) to a real distance (blue). return: the finished distance grid.

syntaxExplanations.6: dist = [] will hold each cell's distance to the nearest 0.
syntaxExplanations.7: for pr in range(rows): builds the grid row by row.

syntaxExplanations.15: for pr in range(rows): sweeps rows top to bottom (pass 1).
syntaxExplanations.16: for pc in range(cols): sweeps columns left to right.

syntaxExplanations.18: if dist[pr-1][pc] + 1 < dist[pr][pc]: is true when the top neighbour is closer.
syntaxExplanations.19: dist[pr][pc] = dist[pr-1][pc] + 1 takes the shorter distance from above.
syntaxExplanations.20: if pc > 0: checks a cell exists to the left.
syntaxExplanations.21: if dist[pr][pc-1] + 1 < dist[pr][pc]: is true when the left neighbour is closer.
syntaxExplanations.22: dist[pr][pc] = dist[pr][pc-1] + 1 takes the shorter distance from the left.
syntaxExplanations.23: for pr in range(rows-1, -1, -1): sweeps rows bottom to top (pass 2).
syntaxExplanations.24: for pc in range(cols-1, -1, -1): sweeps columns right to left.
syntaxExplanations.25: if pr < rows-1: checks a cell exists below.
syntaxExplanations.26: if dist[pr+1][pc] + 1 < dist[pr][pc]: is true when the bottom neighbour is closer.
syntaxExplanations.27: dist[pr][pc] = dist[pr+1][pc] + 1 takes the shorter distance from below.
syntaxExplanations.28: if pc < cols-1: checks a cell exists to the right.
syntaxExplanations.29: if dist[pr][pc+1] + 1 < dist[pr][pc]: is true when the right neighbour is closer.
syntaxExplanations.30: dist[pr][pc] = dist[pr][pc+1] + 1 takes the shorter distance from the right.
syntaxExplanations.31: return dist hands back the distance grid.
